This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - User asked to review the entire dashboard for user-friendliness, specifically disliking the "Complete setup to go live" card design (Card-with-nested-Cards pattern)
   - User then entered plan mode requesting a full pricing restructure: add a 4th "Starter" tier at ~$4.99, research all competitors, ensure pricing beats every competitor on value and price
   - Key user feedback: "make sure all thing is much better than all competitor and make sure its cheaper and better than all competitor", "focus on adding more value provide instead of block more function in starter plan give access of function in limitation something or do it based on best user psychology thing"
   - User confirmed: keep blocked zips in Pro+ only (Recommended option)
   - User approved the final 4-tier pricing plan and all 12 implementation steps were completed

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React Router 7 with `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` (NOT Remix)
   - Shopify Polaris v13 for all UI components
   - Shopify Billing API: `billing.request()`, `billing.check()`, `billing.cancel()`
   - Plan-based feature gating with `PLAN_LIMITS` record keyed by `PlanTier`
   - "Limited access" psychology: Starter gets taste of features (3 delivery rules, 25 waitlist entries, CSV import only) to drive upgrades
   - Server-side enforcement in public APIs (`api.widget-config.tsx`, `api.waitlist.tsx`) — client-side gating alone is insufficient
   - `PlanTier` type: `"free" | "starter" | "pro" | "ultimate"`
   - `PlanLimits` interface with 11 feature flags + label

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`app/plans.ts`** — Foundation of the pricing system. Complete rewrite.
     - Added `PLAN_STARTER_MONTHLY`, `PLAN_STARTER_ANNUAL` constants
     - Exported `PlanTier` type and `PlanLimits` interface
     - `PLAN_LIMITS` expanded with 11 feature flags per tier:
     ```typescript
     export type PlanTier = "free" | "starter" | "pro" | "ultimate";
     export interface PlanLimits {
       maxZipCodes: number; allowBlocked: boolean; maxDeliveryRules: number;
       maxWaitlist: number; csvImport: boolean; csvExport: boolean;
       widgetFullCustom: boolean; showEtaCodReturn: boolean; cartBlocking: boolean;
       customCss: boolean; apiAccess: boolean; label: string;
     }
     // free: 20 zips, starter: 500, pro/ultimate: Infinity
     // free: 0 rules, starter: 3, pro/ultimate: Infinity
     // free: 0 waitlist, starter: 25, pro/ultimate: Infinity
     ```

   - **`app/shopify.server.ts`** — Billing config with new prices.
     - Added Starter Monthly ($4.99) and Annual ($39)
     - Pro: $12.99→$9.99/mo, $99→$79/yr
     - Ultimate: $24.99→$19.99/mo, $199→$149/yr
     - Trial days: 14→7 for all plans
     - Added re-exports: `PLAN_STARTER_MONTHLY`, `PLAN_STARTER_ANNUAL`, `type PlanTier`, `type PlanLimits`

   - **`app/billing.server.ts`** — Updated to use `PlanTier` and `PlanLimits` from plans.ts.
     - Changed `export type PlanTier` to `export type { PlanTier }` (re-export from plans)
     - Changed `limits: (typeof PLAN_LIMITS)[PlanTier]` to `limits: PlanLimits`
     - Removed `as PlanTier` casts (no longer needed since `getPlanTier` returns `PlanTier`)

   - **`app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`** — Complete rewrite for 4 plan cards.
     - 4-column grid: `InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 4 }}`
     - `TIER_ORDER`: `{ free: 0, starter: 1, pro: 2, ultimate: 3 }`
     - Starter features: "Up to 500 zip codes", "Delivery ETA & COD info", "Full widget customization", "3 delivery rules", "Waitlist (25 entries)", "CSV import", "Unlimited searches"
     - Pro keeps "Most popular" badge
     - Dynamic upgrade banner: suggests next tier (free→starter, starter→pro)
     - Trial footnote: "7-day free trial" for free and starter users
     - Annual savings: "Save up to 38%"
     - Button text: "Start 7-day free trial" (was "Start 14-day free trial")
     - Downgrade modal updated: "limited to 20" (was 25)

   - **`app/routes/app._index.tsx`** — Dashboard updated for 4-tier.
     - `planLabel = limits.label` (replaces manual if/else)
     - Added `hasZipLimit = limits.maxZipCodes !== Infinity`
     - Usage bar now shows for both Free and Starter (was Free-only)
     - Upgrade prompt: contextual per tier ("Upgrade to Starter" vs "Upgrade to Pro")
     - Setup banner was redesigned earlier: Banner with numbered List instead of Card-in-Card

   - **`app/routes/app.settings.tsx`** — 4-tier display.
     - Added `starter` to `planBadgeTone` (tone: "success")
     - `planLabel = limits.label`
     - Added Delivery Rules and Waitlist rows to Usage & Limits section
     - Updated "Limited features"/"Essential features" text for free/starter

   - **`app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx`** — Server-side feature enforcement.
     - Fetches subscription alongside config via `Promise.all`
     - Strips widget customization for Free plan (resets to defaults)
     - Strips ETA/zone for plans without `showEtaCodReturn`
     - Strips cart blocking for plans without `cartBlocking`
     - Strips custom CSS for plans without `customCss`

   - **`app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx`** — Waitlist API enforcement.
     - Added plan check before allowing waitlist signup
     - Returns error if `maxWaitlist === 0` (Free plan)
     - Enforces entry count limit for Starter (25 max)

   - **`app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`** — Updated by background agent.
     - Free limit: 25→20
     - CSV import gated by `limits.csvImport` (Starter+)
     - CSV export gated by `limits.csvExport` (Pro+)
     - Contextual upgrade messages per tier

   - **`app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`** — Updated by background agent.
     - Loader: fetches subscription, returns alongside rules/zones
     - Action: blocks creation when at limit (0 for Free, 3 for Starter)
     - Component: Banner for Free users, Badge "X/3 rules used" for Starter, hides Add button for Free

   - **`app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`** — Updated by background agent.
     - Gated behind `limits.maxWaitlist`
     - Free: locked Banner, Starter: view-only (25 max, no bulk notify), Pro+: full access

   - **`app/routes/app.widget.tsx`** — Updated by background agent.
     - Loader returns subscription
     - Layout/Colors: disabled with Badge "Starter+" when `!limits.widgetFullCustom`
     - ETA/COD/Return toggles: disabled with Badge "Starter+" when `!limits.showEtaCodReturn`
     - Cart blocking: disabled with Badge "Pro+" when `!limits.cartBlocking`
     - Custom CSS: disabled with Badge "Ultimate" when `!limits.customCss`
     - Each locked section has an info Banner with "View plans" link

4. Errors and fixes:
   - **TypeScript error: `loading` not in Banner secondaryAction type**: Banner's `secondaryAction` in Polaris v13 doesn't support `loading` prop. Fixed by using conditional text: `content: revalidateState === "loading" ? "Checking..." : "Refresh status"`
   - **TypeScript passed clean** after all 12 implementation steps — no additional errors

5. Problem Solving:
   - Competitor research via WebSearch + WebFetch on 6+ Shopify apps to establish pricing benchmarks
   - Identified key competitive advantages: no search limits, delivery rules (unique), COD/return policy display (unique)
   - Designed "limited access" psychology for Starter tier to drive natural upgrade moments
   - Parallelized implementation with 4 background builder agents for independent file changes
   - Server-side enforcement added to public APIs to prevent client-side bypass

6. All user messages:
   - "whole dashbaord content can you check and make sure its userfriendly according how our app works ? also i dont like top part which i show in screenshot called Complete setup to go live please make it look like how best uio works on shopify for this and check if need any content changes anywhere"
   - "based on whole app function and everything lets plan pricing plan and if want we can make 4 pricing plan as well as we have to introduce small pricing plan of 4.99$ as well or lower whatever work perfect to get better traffic and provide high value. so lets check all in deep and give me full report first"
   - (Plan feedback) "Change feature distribution, make sure all thing is much better than all competitor and make sure ita cheaper and better than all competitor so pricing please make it according it and focus on adding more value provide instead of block more function in starter plan give access of function in limitation something or do it based on best user phycology thing check all our cpompetitor and we have tp provide better pricing function and value and wquality"
   - (Blocked zips) "No, keep in Pro+ only (Recommended)"
   - (Approved the plan and exited plan mode)

7. Pending Tasks:
   - All 12 implementation steps are completed and typecheck passes
   - The waitlist agent and widget agent completed (confirmed via grep showing `getShopSubscription` imported)
   - No explicit pending tasks from the user

8. Current Work:
   All 12 pricing restructure steps are complete. The implementation covers:
   - 4-tier pricing: Free ($0) / Starter ($4.99) / Pro ($9.99) / Ultimate ($19.99)
   - Feature gating across all admin pages (zip-codes, delivery-rules, waitlist, widget)
   - Server-side enforcement in public APIs (widget-config, waitlist)
   - Dashboard, settings, and pricing page updated for 4 tiers
   - TypeScript validation passes clean
   - 3 background agents completed (zip-codes, waitlist, widget) and 1 confirmed completed (delivery-rules)

9. Optional Next Step:
   Run `npm run typecheck` one final time to confirm all agent changes compile correctly, since 3 agents made changes after the last typecheck. Then inform the user that the full 4-tier pricing restructure is complete and ready for testing.

If you need specific details from before compaction (like exact code snippets, error messages, or content you generated), read the full transcript at: /Users/yashbaldha/.claude/projects/-Users-yashbaldha-Desktop-Shopify-App-Zip-Code/0c9b01f6-3c75-44f4-af17-093fb2bd4d25.jsonl
Continue the conversation from where it left off without asking the user any further questions. Resume directly — do not acknowledge the summary, do not recap what was happening, do not preface with "I'll continue" or similar. Pick up the last task as if the break never happened.

content.text: All 4 background agents have now completed successfully. The entire 4-tier pricing restructure is fully implemented and typecheck-verified. Ready for `npm run dev` testing.

Pricing Restructure — 4-Tier Plan (Competitor-Beating)
Context
The app currently has 3 tiers (Free / Pro $12.99 / Ultimate $24.99). The jump from $0 to $12.99 is too large for small merchants. We're adding a Starter tier and repricing all tiers to beat every competitor on both price AND value. The strategy uses "limited access" psychology — Starter gets a taste of advanced features (limited delivery rules, limited waitlist) so merchants see the value and upgrade naturally.

Competitor Analysis
App	Free	Tier 2	Tier 3	Tier 4	Unique limits
Zipprover (5.0★, 40 reviews)	Basic, 1 rule, branding	$4.99 — 500 checks/mo, CSS	$12.99 — 1K checks, block ATC, product rules	$19.99 — 2K checks, ETA, waitlist	Limits monthly SEARCHES
Zippy (top competitor)	1 zone, 750 searches	$5.97 — 3 zones, 2.5K searches	$15.97 — 10 zones, unlimited	--	Limits zones + searches
SB Zipcode Validator	--	$1.99 — unlimited zips, basic widget	--	--	Single plan, very basic
Smart Zipcode Tracker	250 zips, 500 hits	$4.99 — 500 zips, 2K hits	$9.99 — 2K zips, 5K hits	$14.99 — unlimited	Limits zips + monthly hits
MeroxIO Checker	10 zips	$4.99 — unlimited, analytics, ATC block	--	--	2 tiers only
Easy Zipcode (Avocados) (5.0★, 33 reviews)	--	$4.99 — unlimited zips	$7.99 — checkout block, CSS	$9.99 — waitlist, social proof	No free plan
Our Competitive Advantages (features NO competitor has)
Delivery rules with fees, cutoff times, delivery days, priority — UNIQUE
No search/check limits — we never charge per validation (competitors limit 500-2K/mo)
COD availability + return policy display — UNIQUE
Social proof (waitlist count on widget) — only Easy Zipcode has this at $9.99+
Zone-based delivery fees — only Zapiet does this but at enterprise pricing
Cart + checkout blocking — competitors charge $7.99-$12.99 for this
New 4-Tier Pricing
Free	Starter	Pro ⭐	Ultimate
Monthly	$0	$4.99	$9.99	$19.99
Annual	--	$39/yr ($3.25/mo)	$79/yr ($6.58/mo)	$149/yr ($12.42/mo)
Annual savings	--	35%	34%	38%
Trial	--	7 days	7 days	7 days
Why this beats every competitor:
Starter $4.99 matches market entry price but gives WAY more value (delivery rules + waitlist access, which competitors charge $12.99-$19.99 for)
Pro $9.99 undercuts Zipprover ($12.99) and Zippy ($15.97) while offering unlimited everything
Ultimate $19.99 matches Zipprover's top tier but includes delivery rules, API, custom CSS — features they don't even have
Unlimited searches on ALL plans — Zipprover caps at 500-2K/mo, Zippy caps at 750-2.5K, Smart caps at 500-5K
Feature Matrix (Psychology: "limited access" on Starter)
Feature	Free	Starter	Pro ⭐	Ultimate
Zip code limit	20	500	Unlimited	Unlimited
Searches/checks	Unlimited	Unlimited	Unlimited	Unlimited
Allowed zip codes	Yes	Yes	Yes	Yes
Blocked zip codes	No	No	Yes	Yes
Zone organization	No	Yes	Yes	Yes
ETA display	No	Yes	Yes	Yes
COD availability	No	Yes	Yes	Yes
Return policy display	No	Yes	Yes	Yes
Widget customization	Basic (text only)	Full (colors, text, position)	Full	Full
Delivery rules	No	3 rules (limited)	Unlimited	Unlimited
Customer waitlist	No	View only (25 entries max)	Full + bulk notify	Full + bulk notify
CSV import	No	Import only (up to 500)	Full import + export	Full import + export
Cart blocking	No	No	Yes	Yes
Custom CSS	No	No	No	Yes
API access	No	No	No	Yes
Support	Standard email	Email support	Priority email	24/7 VIP
Early access	No	No	No	Yes
Psychology behind "limited access" on Starter:
3 delivery rules — merchant sets up rules, sees the power, hits the limit, upgrades to Pro for unlimited
Waitlist view-only (25 entries) — sees customer demand building up, can't bulk notify → upgrades to act on it
CSV import only (no export) — can upload zips easily but can't export/backup → Pro unlocks full control
This creates natural "aha moments" that drive upgrades without frustrating the merchant
How We Beat Each Competitor
vs Competitor	How we win

// ─── Loader ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const { session, billing } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const shop = session.shop;

  try {
    /* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */
    const billingCheck = await billing.check({
      plans: ALL_PAID_PLANS as any,
      isTest: process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production",
    });
    /* eslint-enable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */
    const subscription = await syncSubscriptionFromShopify(
      shop,
      billingCheck.appSubscriptions ?? [],
    );
    return { subscription };
  } catch {
    const subscription = await getShopSubscription(shop);
    return { subscription };
  }
};

// ─── Action ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const action = async ({ request }: ActionFunctionArgs): Promise<
  | { confirmationUrl: string }
  | { error: string }
  | { success: boolean; message: string }
  | null
> => {
  const { session, billing } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const shop = session.shop;
  const formData = await request.formData();
  const intent = String(formData.get("intent"));

  if (intent === "subscribe") {
    const plan = String(formData.get("plan"));
    const returnUrl = `${process.env.SHOPIFY_APP_URL}/app/pricing`;
    try {
      /* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */
      const confirmationUrl = await billing.request({
        plan: plan as any,
        isTest: process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production",
        returnUrl,
      }) as string;
      /* eslint-enable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */
      return { confirmationUrl };
    } catch {
      return { error: "Failed to initiate subscription. Please try again." };
    }
  }

  if (intent === "cancel") {
    try {
      const sub = await getShopSubscription(shop);
      if (sub.shopifySubscriptionId) {
        await billing.cancel({
          subscriptionId: sub.shopifySubscriptionId,
          isTest: process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production",
          prorate: true,
        });
      }
      await cancelShopSubscription(shop);
      return {
        success: true,
        message: "Subscription cancelled. You are now on the Free plan.",
      };
    } catch {
      return { error: "Failed to cancel subscription. Please try again." };
    }
  }

  return null;
};

type PlanCardProps = {
  plan: (typeof PLANS_DATA)[keyof typeof PLANS_DATA];
  isAnnual: boolean;
  currentTier: string;
  onSubscribe: (planName: string) => void;
  onRequestCancel: () => void;
  loadingPlan: string | null;
};

function PlanCard({
  plan,
  isAnnual,
  currentTier,
  onSubscribe,
  onRequestCancel,
  loadingPlan,
}: PlanCardProps) {
  const isCurrent = currentTier === plan.id;
  const isBestValue = "bestValue" in plan && plan.bestValue;
  const isCurrentPaid = currentTier !== "free";
  const isDowngradeToFree = plan.id === "free" && isCurrentPaid;

  const TIER_ORDER: Record<string, number> = {
    free: 0,
    starter: 1,
    pro: 2,
    ultimate: 3,
  };
  const isUpgrade =
    !isCurrent &&
    plan.id !== "free" &&
    (TIER_ORDER[plan.id] ?? 0) > (TIER_ORDER[currentTier] ?? 0);

  const shopifyPlan = isAnnual
    ? plan.shopifyPlanAnnual
    : plan.shopifyPlanMonthly;

  const displayPrice = isAnnual ? plan.annualMonthlyPrice : plan.monthlyPrice;

  let buttonContent = "Start 7-day free trial";
  if (isCurrent) {
    buttonContent = "Current plan";
  } else if (isDowngradeToFree) {
    buttonContent = "Downgrade to Free";
  } else if (isUpgrade) {
    buttonContent = `Upgrade to ${plan.name}`;
  } else if (!isCurrent && plan.id !== "free" && isCurrentPaid) {
    buttonContent = `Switch to ${plan.name}`;
  }

  const handleClick = () => {
    if (isCurrent) return;
    if (isDowngradeToFree) {
      onRequestCancel();
    } else if (shopifyPlan) {
      onSubscribe(shopifyPlan);
    }
  };

  const isThisLoading = loadingPlan === (shopifyPlan ?? "cancel");

  return (
    <Card>
      <BlockStack gap="400">

        {/* Plan name + badges */}
        <BlockStack gap="100">
          <InlineStack align="space-between" blockAlign="center">
            <Text as="h3" variant="headingMd" fontWeight="bold">
              {plan.name}
            </Text>
            <InlineStack gap="150">
              {isBestValue && (
                <Badge tone="info" icon={StarIcon}>
                  Most popular
                </Badge>
              )}
              {isCurrent && <Badge tone="success">Active</Badge>}
            </InlineStack>
          </InlineStack>
          <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
            {plan.description}
          </Text>
        </BlockStack>

        <Divider />

        {/* Price */}
        <BlockStack gap="100">
          {plan.monthlyPrice === 0 ? (
            <>
              <Text as="p" variant="headingXl" fontWeight="bold">
                Free
              </Text>
              <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                forever
              </Text>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <InlineStack gap="100" blockAlign="baseline">
                <Text as="p" variant="headingXl" fontWeight="bold">
                  ${displayPrice}
                </Text>
                <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                  / month
                </Text>
              </InlineStack>
              <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                {isAnnual
                  ? `billed $${plan.annualPrice} / year`
                  : `or $${plan.annualMonthlyPrice}/mo billed annually`}
              </Text>
            </>
          )}
        </BlockStack>

        {/* CTA button */}
        <Button
          variant={isCurrent ? "secondary" : "primary"}
          tone={isDowngradeToFree ? "critical" : undefined}
          onClick={handleClick}
          disabled={isCurrent}
          loading={isThisLoading}
          fullWidth
        >
          {buttonContent}
        </Button>

        <Divider />

        {/* Features list */}
        <BlockStack gap="300">
          {plan.features.map((f) => (
            <PlanFeature key={f} feature={f} />
          ))}
        </BlockStack>

      </BlockStack>
    </Card>
  );
}

                      : PLANS_DATA[nextTier].shopifyPlanMonthly;

                </Text>
              </Banner>

                <InlineStack gap="200" blockAlign="center">

                  <Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">
                    {currentTier === "ultimate"
                      ? "You have full access to all features including VIP support and API access."
                      : "You have unlimited zip codes, blocked areas, delivery rules, and more."}
                  </Text>
                </InlineStack>
              </Banner>
            )}

            {/* Action feedback banners */}
            {data && "error" in data && data.error && (
              <Banner tone="critical">{String(data.error)}</Banner>
            )}
            {data && "success" in data && data.success && (
              <Banner tone="success">
                {data && "message" in data
                  ? String(data.message)
                  : "Plan updated successfully."}
              </Banner>
            )}

            {/* Billing toggle */}
            <BlockStack gap="200" inlineAlign="center">
              <ButtonGroup variant="segmented">
                <Button
                  pressed={!isAnnual}
                  onClick={() => setIsAnnual(false)}
                >
                  Monthly
                </Button>
                <Button
                  pressed={isAnnual}
                  onClick={() => setIsAnnual(true)}
                >
                  Annual · Save up to 38%
                </Button>
              </ButtonGroup>
              {isAnnual && (
                <Badge tone="success">You save up to 38% per year</Badge>
              )}
            </BlockStack>

            {/* Plan cards — 4 columns */}
            <InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 4 }} gap="400">
              {(
                Object.values(
                  PLANS_DATA,
                ) as (typeof PLANS_DATA)[keyof typeof PLANS_DATA][]
              ).map((plan) => (
                <PlanCard
                  key={plan.id}
                  plan={plan}
                  isAnnual={isAnnual}
                  currentTier={currentTier}
                  onSubscribe={handleSubscribe}
                  onRequestCancel={() => setCancelModalOpen(true)}
                  loadingPlan={loadingPlan}
                />
              ))}
            </InlineGrid>

            {/* Trial footnote */}
            {(currentTier === "free" || currentTier === "starter") && (

                as="p"
                variant="bodySm"
                tone="subdued"
                alignment="center"
              >

                charged until the trial ends.
              </Text>

          </BlockStack>
        </Layout.Section>
      </Layout>
      </Box>

      {/* Downgrade confirmation modal */}
      <Modal
        open={cancelModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setCancelModalOpen(false)}
        title="Downgrade to Free plan?"
        primaryAction={{
          content: "Yes, downgrade",
          destructive: true,
          onAction: handleConfirmCancel,
          loading: loadingPlan === "cancel",

        secondaryActions={[
          {
            content: "Keep current plan",
            onAction: () => setCancelModalOpen(false),

            <BlockStack gap="200">

                  <Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">{item}</Text>

              </Text>

Honestly, **I'd recommend against it** for these reasons:

1. **Pricing isn't a daily-use page** — merchants visit it once to pick a plan, then rarely return. Putting it in the main nav wastes a slot on something they'll use 1-2 times.

2. **Shopify UX convention** — most Shopify apps keep billing/pricing inside Settings or link to it contextually (upgrade banners, limit warnings). That's what merchants expect.

3. **You already have contextual upgrade prompts everywhere** — the dashboard, zip codes, delivery rules, waitlist, and widget pages all show upgrade banners when users hit limits. These are more effective than a nav link because they appear at the *moment of need*.

4. **Nav clutter** — you already have 7 nav items. Adding more makes the menu harder to scan.

**Better alternatives:**
- Keep pricing accessible from the **Settings** page (plan section with "View plans" link) — already done
- Keep the **contextual upgrade banners** on each page — already done
- The dashboard already shows the current plan with an upgrade CTA — already done

    16→  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
    17→  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, OPTIONS",
    18→  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
    19→  "Content-Type": "application/json",
    20→};

    22→const DEFAULTS = {
    23→  position: "inline",
    24→  primaryColor: "#008060",
    25→  successColor: "#008060",
    26→  errorColor: "#D72C0D",
    27→  backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
    28→  textColor: "#202223",
    29→  heading: "Check Delivery Availability",
    30→  placeholder: "Enter your zip code",
    31→  buttonText: "Check",
    32→  successMessage: "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
    33→  errorMessage: "Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.",
    34→  notFoundMessage: "This zip code was not found in our system.",
    35→  showEta: true,
    36→  showZone: false,
    37→  showWaitlistOnFailure: false,
    38→  blockCartOnInvalid: false,

    40→  showSocialProof: true,

    45→/**

    47→ * <style> element. Strips known injection vectors:
    48→ *   - </style> close tags  — would break out of the enclosing style block
    49→ *   - @import directives   — would load arbitrary external stylesheets
    50→ *   - expression()         — IE-era JS-in-CSS execution vector
    51→ *   - javascript: URLs     — covers url(javascript:...) and similar
    52→ */
    53→function sanitizeCss(css: string): string {
    54→  return css
    55→    // Break out of <style> blocks
    56→    .replace(/<\/style>/gi, "")
    57→    // External stylesheet loading
    58→    .replace(/@import\b[^;]*(;|$)/gi, "")
    59→    // IE expression() — JS execution inside CSS property values
    60→    .replace(/\bexpression\s*\(/gi, "")
    61→    // javascript: protocol inside url() references
    62→    .replace(/url\s*\(\s*['"]?\s*javascript\s*:/gi, "url(");
    63→}

    66→  if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
    67→    return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS_HEADERS });
    68→  }

    70→  const url = new URL(request.url);
    71→  const shop = url.searchParams.get("shop");
    72→
    73→  if (!shop) {
    74→    return new Response(
    75→      JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing shop parameter" }),
    76→      { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
    77→    );
    78→  }
    79→
    80→  // Validate shop is a real myshopify.com domain (prevents cross-shop config enumeration)
    81→  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*\.myshopify\.com$/.test(shop) || shop.length > 100) {
    82→    return new Response(
    83→      JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid shop parameter" }),
    84→      { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
    85→    );
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const [config, subscription] = await Promise.all([
    89→    db.widgetConfig.findUnique({ where: { shop } }),
    90→    getShopSubscription(shop),
    91→  ]);
    92→
    93→  const limits = subscription.limits;
    94→
    95→  const raw = config
    96→    ? {
    97→        position: config.position,
    98→        primaryColor: config.primaryColor,
    99→        successColor: config.successColor,
   100→        errorColor: config.errorColor,
   101→        backgroundColor: config.backgroundColor,
   102→        textColor: config.textColor,
   103→        heading: config.heading,
   104→        placeholder: config.placeholder,
   105→        buttonText: config.buttonText,
   106→        successMessage: config.successMessage,
   107→        errorMessage: config.errorMessage,
   108→        notFoundMessage: config.notFoundMessage,
   109→        showEta: config.showEta,
   110→        showZone: config.showZone,
   111→        showWaitlistOnFailure: config.showWaitlistOnFailure,
   112→        blockCartOnInvalid: config.blockCartOnInvalid ?? false,
   113→        blockCheckoutInCart: config.blockCheckoutInCart ?? false,
   114→        showSocialProof: config.showSocialProof ?? true,

   116→        customCss: config.customCss ? sanitizeCss(config.customCss) : null,
   117→      }

   122→    ...raw,
   123→    // Free plan: reset to defaults for colors/position
   124→    ...(limits.widgetFullCustom
   125→      ? {}
   126→      : {
   127→          position: DEFAULTS.position,
   128→          primaryColor: DEFAULTS.primaryColor,
   129→          successColor: DEFAULTS.successColor,
   130→          errorColor: DEFAULTS.errorColor,
   131→          backgroundColor: DEFAULTS.backgroundColor,
   132→          textColor: DEFAULTS.textColor,
   133→        }),
   134→    // ETA/COD/Return policy toggles
   135→    ...(limits.showEtaCodReturn ? {} : { showEta: false, showZone: false }),
   136→    // Cart blocking
   137→    ...(limits.cartBlocking
   138→      ? {}
   139→      : { blockCartOnInvalid: false, blockCheckoutInCart: false }),
   140→    // Custom CSS
   141→    ...(limits.customCss ? {} : { customCss: null }),
   142→  };
   143→
   144→  return new Response(JSON.stringify(payload), {
   145→    status: 200,
   146→    headers: {
   147→      ...CORS_HEADERS,
   148→      "Cache-Control": "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate",
   149→    },
   150→  });
   151→};

1→# Zip Code Checker — Shopify App
     2→
     3→A Shopify embedded app that lets merchants control delivery availability by zip code. Built with React Router 7, Shopify Polaris, and Prisma.
     4→
     5→## Features
     6→
     7→- **Zip Code Management** — Add, edit, activate/deactivate allowed and blocked zip codes
     8→- **Delivery Zones & ETAs** — Group zip codes into zones with estimated delivery times
     9→- **Delivery Rules** — Zone-based rules for fees, minimum order amounts, cutoff times, and schedules
    10→- **Customer Waitlist** — Capture emails from unsupported areas and notify when coverage expands
    11→- **Widget Customisation** — Style the storefront zip code checker widget without touching code
    12→- **Billing** — Free, Pro, and Ultimate plans via Shopify App Subscriptions
    13→
    14→## Tech Stack
    15→
    16→- [React Router 7](https://reactrouter.com) (full-stack)
    17→- [Shopify Polaris](https://polaris.shopify.com) v13
    18→- [Shopify App React Router](https://github.com/Shopify/shopify-app-js)
    19→- [Prisma](https://www.prisma.io) ORM (SQLite for dev, PostgreSQL for production)
    20→- TypeScript, Vite
    21→
    22→## Development
    23→
    24→### Prerequisites
    25→
    26→- Node.js ≥ 20.19
    27→- A [Shopify Partner](https://partners.shopify.com) account and development store
    28→
    29→### Setup
    30→
    31→```bash
    32→npm install
    33→npm run setup        # prisma generate + migrate
    34→npm run dev          # shopify app dev
    35→```
    36→
    37→### Scripts
    38→
    39→| Command | Description |
    40→|---------|-------------|
    41→| `npm run dev` | Start local dev server via Shopify CLI |
    42→| `npm run build` | Build for production |
    43→| `npm run start` | Serve the built app |
    44→| `npm run setup` | Generate Prisma client and run migrations |
    45→| `npm run deploy` | Deploy to Shopify |
    46→| `npm run typecheck` | TypeScript type checking |
    47→| `npm run lint` | ESLint |
    48→
    49→## Production Database
    50→
    51→Switch from SQLite to PostgreSQL for production:
    52→
    53→1. Update `prisma/schema.prisma`:
    54→   ```prisma
    55→   datasource db {
    56→     provider = "postgresql"
    57→     url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
    58→   }
    59→   ```
    60→2. Set `DATABASE_URL` to your PostgreSQL connection string
    61→3. Run `npm run setup`
    62→
    63→## Public API
    64→
    65→The storefront widget calls a public endpoint to check zip code availability:
    66→
    67→```
    68→GET /api/zip-check?shop=store.myshopify.com&zip=12345
    69→POST /api/zip-check  { "shop": "store.myshopify.com", "zip": "12345" }
    70→```
    71→
    72→Response:
    73→```json
    74→{ "allowed": true, "message": "We deliver to your area!", "eta": "2-3 days", "zone": "North" }
    75→```
    76→
    77→## GDPR Compliance
    78→
    79→The app implements all three mandatory GDPR webhooks required by Shopify:
    80→
    81→- `customers/data_request` — logs customer data requests for manual fulfilment
    82→- `customers/redact` — deletes customer PII (waitlist entries)
    83→- `shop/redact` — deletes all shop data 48 hours after uninstall
    84→
    85→## Shopify App Store
    86→
    87→This app is designed for submission to the Shopify App Store and follows all [Shopify app requirements](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/app-requirements).

# Shopify App Store Requirements - Comprehensive Extraction

## 1. POLICY REQUIREMENTS

### 1.1 Build and Operate Within Shopify's Platform
- **1.1.1 Session Token Authentication**: "Your embedded app must function properly without relying on third-party cookies or local storage"
- **1.1.2 Use Shopify Checkout**: Cannot bypass checkout or process transactions outside official payment systems
- **1.1.3 Theme Store Compliance**: Apps cannot enable merchants to download themes; must direct to official Theme Store
- **1.1.4 Factual Information Only**: "Your app and app listing should only include factual information"
- **1.1.5 Unique Apps**: Cannot publish identical duplicate apps
- **1.1.6 Single-Merchant Storefronts**: Marketplace-style classifieds apps prohibited; use sales channels instead
- **1.1.7 Payment Gateway Authorization**: "Payment Gateway apps must be authorized through an application process"
- **1.1.8 Shopify POS Only**: Cannot connect to third-party POS systems
- **1.1.9 Explicit Buyer Consent**: "Apps can only add optional charges to carts or at checkout after displaying the additional cost...upon obtaining explicit buyer consent"
- **1.1.10 Default Cheapest Shipping**: "The cheapest shipping option must always be selected by default"
- **1.1.11 Browser Extensions as Optional**: Extensions permitted only as optional features, not required
- **1.1.12 Web-Based Apps**: Cannot require desktop applications for functionality
- **1.1.13 Authorized Product Data Only**: Can only duplicate merchant's own products, licensed, or dropshipped items
- **1.1.14 No Agency/Freelancer Connections**: Apps connecting merchants to external agencies/developers prohibited
- **1.1.15 Refund Processing**: "Your app must not offer methods for processing refunds outside of the original payment processor"
- **1.1.16 No Capital Lending**: Cannot provide loans, cash advances, or receivables purchasing

### 1.2 Billing Compliance
- **1.2.1 Shopify Billing Systems Required**: "Your app must use Managed Pricing or the Shopify Billing API for any app charges"
- **1.2.2 Correct Implementation**: Must properly implement billing systems with charge acceptance/denial and reinstall approval
- **1.2.3 Plan Change Flexibility**: "Your app must allow merchants to upgrade and downgrade their pricing plan without having to contact support"

---

## 2. FUNCTIONALITY REQUIREMENTS

### 2.1 Reliability and User Experience
- **2.1.1 Critical Error Freedom**: "Your app must be free from user interface bugs, display issues, or error pages that fully prevent completion of the review"
- **2.1.2 Minor Error Freedom**: Must eliminate bugs that partially impede review completion
- **2.1.3 Interactive UI Requirement**: All apps must have operational user interface regardless of launch method
- **2.1.4 Data Synchronization Accuracy**: "If your app synchronizes data with Shopify, then it must ensure accurate and correct transfer of data between both platforms"

### 2.2 API and Platform Integration
- **2.2.1 Shopify API Usage**: "Your app must be configured to use Shopify's API to ensure it best serves merchants"
- **2.2.2 Consistent Embedded Experience**: Off-platform features must integrate directly within Shopify Admin
- **2.2.3 Latest App Bridge Version**: All apps must use latest Shopify App Bridge as of March 13, 2024
- **2.2.4 GraphQL Admin API Mandate**: As of April 1, 2025, new public apps must use exclusively "GraphQL Admin API"
- **2.2.5 Feature-Complete Admin Extensions**: Admin UI blocks and actions must provide complete, novel functionality
- **2.2.6 No Admin Extension Promotions**: Cannot use admin extensions for app promotion, upselling, or review requests
- **2.2.7 Max Modal Interaction Requirement**: Modal launches require merchant interaction; cannot launch from navigation menu

### 2.3 Installation Security
- **2.3.1 Shopify Surface Installation**: "Apps must be installed and initiated only on Shopify services"
- **2.3.2 Immediate OAuth Authentication**: OAuth required before merchant UI interaction
- **2.3.3 Post-OAuth UI Redirection**: Must redirect to app UI after OAuth permission acceptance
- **2.3.4 Reinstall OAuth Requirement**: OAuth required immediately upon reinstall, even for previous users

---

## 3. SECURITY REQUIREMENTS

### 3.1 Data Encryption
- **3.1.1 Valid TLS/SSL Certificate**: "All data exchanged between a client...and your app server should be encrypted using Transport Layer Security"

### 3.2 Access Scope Minimization
- **3.2.1 read_all_orders Justification**: Must demonstrate necessity for this scope
- **3.2.2 write_payment_mandate Justification**: Must show required for app functionality
- **3.2.3 write_checkout_extensions_apis Justification**: Justify this scope's necessity
- **3.2.4 read_advanced_dom_pixel_events Justification**: Must implement heatmap or session recording if requested
- **3.2.5 read_checkout_extensions_chat Justification**: Justify when necessary

---

## 4. APP STORE LISTING REQUIREMENTS

### 4.1 Branding Consistency
- **4.1.1 Matching App Names**: Names in Developer Dashboard and submission form must match or contain common words
- **4.1.2 Identical App Icon**: Icon must match between Dev Dashboard and app listing

### 4.2 Pricing Accuracy and Placement

# Pricing Restructure — 4-Tier Plan (Competitor-Beating)

## Context
The app currently has 3 tiers (Free / Pro $12.99 / Ultimate $24.99). The jump from $0 to $12.99 is too large for small merchants. We're adding a **Starter** tier and repricing all tiers to beat every competitor on both price AND value. The strategy uses "limited access" psychology — Starter gets a taste of advanced features (limited delivery rules, limited waitlist) so merchants see the value and upgrade naturally.

---

## Competitor Analysis

| App | Free | Tier 2 | Tier 3 | Tier 4 | Unique limits |
|-----|------|--------|--------|--------|---------------|
| **Zipprover** (5.0★, 40 reviews) | Basic, 1 rule, branding | $4.99 — 500 checks/mo, CSS | $12.99 — 1K checks, block ATC, product rules | $19.99 — 2K checks, ETA, waitlist | Limits monthly SEARCHES |
| **Zippy** (top competitor) | 1 zone, 750 searches | $5.97 — 3 zones, 2.5K searches | $15.97 — 10 zones, unlimited | -- | Limits zones + searches |
| **SB Zipcode Validator** | -- | $1.99 — unlimited zips, basic widget | -- | -- | Single plan, very basic |
| **Smart Zipcode Tracker** | 250 zips, 500 hits | $4.99 — 500 zips, 2K hits | $9.99 — 2K zips, 5K hits | $14.99 — unlimited | Limits zips + monthly hits |
| **MeroxIO Checker** | 10 zips | $4.99 — unlimited, analytics, ATC block | -- | -- | 2 tiers only |
| **Easy Zipcode (Avocados)** (5.0★, 33 reviews) | -- | $4.99 — unlimited zips | $7.99 — checkout block, CSS | $9.99 — waitlist, social proof | No free plan |

### Our Competitive Advantages (features NO competitor has)
1. **Delivery rules** with fees, cutoff times, delivery days, priority — UNIQUE
2. **No search/check limits** — we never charge per validation (competitors limit 500-2K/mo)
3. **COD availability + return policy display** — UNIQUE
4. **Social proof** (waitlist count on widget) — only Easy Zipcode has this at $9.99+
5. **Zone-based delivery fees** — only Zapiet does this but at enterprise pricing
6. **Cart + checkout blocking** — competitors charge $7.99-$12.99 for this

---

## New 4-Tier Pricing

| | **Free** | **Starter** | **Pro** ⭐ | **Ultimate** |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Monthly** | $0 | $4.99 | $9.99 | $19.99 |
| **Annual** | -- | $39/yr ($3.25/mo) | $79/yr ($6.58/mo) | $149/yr ($12.42/mo) |
| **Annual savings** | -- | 35% | 34% | 38% |
| **Trial** | -- | 7 days | 7 days | 7 days |

### Why this beats every competitor:
- **Starter $4.99** matches market entry price but gives WAY more value (delivery rules + waitlist access, which competitors charge $12.99-$19.99 for)
- **Pro $9.99** undercuts Zipprover ($12.99) and Zippy ($15.97) while offering unlimited everything
- **Ultimate $19.99** matches Zipprover's top tier but includes delivery rules, API, custom CSS — features they don't even have
- **Unlimited searches on ALL plans** — Zipprover caps at 500-2K/mo, Zippy caps at 750-2.5K, Smart caps at 500-5K

# Shopify App Store Compliance Audit & Fixes

## Context
Before submitting the Zip Code Checker app to the Shopify App Store, we need to ensure full compliance with all App Store requirements. This audit compares our codebase against the official requirements at https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/shopify-app-store/app-store-requirements and identifies issues to fix.

---

## Audit Results

### PASSING (No changes needed)
- ✅ **Session token auth** — embedded app, PrismaSessionStorage, no third-party cookies
- ✅ **Shopify Billing API** — properly implemented with lineItems format, all 6 plans
- ✅ **Plan change flexibility** — upgrade/downgrade without contacting support
- ✅ **Authentication** — all `app.*.tsx` routes call `authenticate.admin(request)`
- ✅ **Theme App Extensions** — proper structure in `extensions/zip-code-widget/`
- ✅ **Webhook handlers** — app/uninstalled, app_subscriptions/update, GDPR webhooks all exist
- ✅ **Data cleanup on uninstall** — all shop data deleted (Session, ZipCode, DeliveryRule, WaitlistEntry, WidgetConfig, Subscription, ShopSettings)
- ✅ **GDPR customers/redact** — deletes PII (waitlist entries by email)
- ✅ **GDPR shop/redact** — deletes all shop data
- ✅ **Minimal scopes** — only `read_themes` (justified for embed detection)
- ✅ **Polaris v13 only** — no raw HTML layouts
- ✅ **Input validation on public APIs** — shop domain regex, zip/email length limits
- ✅ **CSS sanitization** — `sanitizeCss()` strips dangerous patterns in widget-config
- ✅ **CORS headers** — properly configured on all public API routes
- ✅ **Boundary headers** — all admin routes export `headers` function
- ✅ **Latest App Bridge** — using `@shopify/app-bridge-react` v4
- ✅ **Loading states** — global skeleton during navigation transitions

---

### ISSUES TO FIX

#### Issue 1: REST API usage → Must use GraphQL Admin API
**Requirement:** "As of April 1, 2025, new public apps must use exclusively GraphQL Admin API" (§2.2.4)
**Problem:** Dashboard (`app._index.tsx` lines 51-68) uses raw `fetch()` to call REST endpoints:
- `GET /admin/api/2026-01/themes.json`
- `GET /admin/api/2026-01/themes/{id}/assets.json`
**Fix:** Replace with GraphQL queries using the authenticated `admin` GraphQL client from `authenticate.admin()`.
**File:** `app/routes/app._index.tsx`

#### Issue 2: GDPR compliance webhook URLs not registered
**Requirement:** Mandatory GDPR webhooks must be configured in Partner Dashboard
**Problem:** The TOML only registers 3 webhooks (app/scopes_update, app/uninstalled, app_subscriptions/update). The GDPR webhooks (customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact) must be registered in the Partner Dashboard under App Setup → Data Protection.
**Fix:** Add compliance webhook topics to `shopify.app.toml` so they auto-register on deploy:
```toml
[[webhooks.subscriptions]]
topics = [ "customers/data_request" ]
uri = "/webhooks/customers/data_request"

[[webhooks.subscriptions]]
topics = [ "customers/redact" ]
uri = "/webhooks/customers/redact"

[[webhooks.subscriptions]]
topics = [ "shop/redact" ]
uri = "/webhooks/shop/redact"
```
**File:** `shopify.app.toml`

#### Issue 3: Missing route-level ErrorBoundary exports
**Requirement:** "Your app must be free from error pages that fully prevent completion of the review" (§2.1.1)
**Problem:** Only `app.tsx` exports ErrorBoundary. If a single route crashes, the entire app shell shows the error boundary instead of a graceful per-page fallback.
**Fix:** Add `ErrorBoundary` export to all admin routes using `boundary.error()`:
**Files:** `app.zip-codes.tsx`, `app.delivery-rules.tsx`, `app.waitlist.tsx`, `app.widget.tsx`, `app.settings.tsx`, `app.pricing.tsx`, `app._index.tsx`, `app.help.tsx`

#### Issue 4: Remove debug logging from production code
**Requirement:** Production readiness, clean console
**Problem:** `app.pricing.tsx` has verbose `console.error` debug logging (lines 178-179) for billing errors. Webhook handlers have `console.log` with shop names and customer IDs.
**Fix:** Remove or wrap debug logs in `NODE_ENV !== "production"` checks.
**Files:** `app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`, webhook route files

#### Issue 5: App listing completeness (Partner Dashboard)
**Requirement:** Multiple listing requirements (§4.x)
**Action items (in Partner Dashboard, not code):**
- Add privacy policy URL
- Ensure app name matches between Dashboard and TOML
- Add detailed app description with feature list
- Add screenshots showing actual UI (no pricing in images)
- Record and upload demo screencast
- Add test account credentials for reviewer
- Add emergency developer contact
- Set correct category tags
- No "best" or "first" claims in listing text

---

## Implementation Steps

### Step 1: Convert REST API to GraphQL (`app._index.tsx`)
Replace the raw `fetch()` calls for themes with the GraphQL client:
```typescript
const { admin } = await authenticate.admin(request);

// Get main theme
const themeResponse = await admin.graphql(`{
  themes(first: 1, roles: MAIN) {
    nodes {
      id
      name
      files(filenames: ["config/settings_data.json"], first: 1) {
        nodes {
          body {
            ... on OnlineStoreThemeFileBodyText {
              content
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}`);
```
This replaces both REST calls (themes.json + assets.json) with a single GraphQL query.

### Step 2: Register GDPR webhooks (`shopify.app.toml`)
Add 3 compliance webhook subscriptions to the TOML file. These will auto-register on `shopify app deploy`.

### Step 3: Add ErrorBoundary to all admin routes
Add to each `app.*.tsx` file:
```typescript
export function ErrorBoundary() {
  return boundary.error(useRouteError());
}
```
Import `useRouteError` from `react-router` and `boundary` from `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server`.

### Step 4: Clean up debug logging
- In `app.pricing.tsx`: remove verbose `console.error` billing debug logs, keep only the user-facing error message
- In webhook files: remove `console.log` with shop/customer details, or guard with env check

---

## Files to Modify

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `app/routes/app._index.tsx` | Replace REST fetch with GraphQL for theme/embed detection |
| `shopify.app.toml` | Add 3 GDPR webhook subscriptions |
| `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` | Add ErrorBoundary export |
| `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx` | Add ErrorBoundary export |
| `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` | Add ErrorBoundary export |
| `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` | Add ErrorBoundary export |
| `app/routes/app.settings.tsx` | Add ErrorBoundary export |
| `app/routes/app.pricing.tsx` | Add ErrorBoundary export + clean debug logs |
| `app/routes/app._index.tsx` | Add ErrorBoundary export |
| `app/routes/app.help.tsx` | Add ErrorBoundary export |
| `app/routes/webhooks.*.tsx` | Clean console.log statements |

---

## Verification
1. `npm run typecheck` passes
2. Dashboard loads correctly with GraphQL theme detection (embed status works)
3. `npx shopify app deploy` registers all webhooks including GDPR
4. Each admin page handles errors gracefully (test by temporarily breaking a loader)
5. No verbose debug logs in terminal during normal operation
6. Partner Dashboard checklist: privacy URL, screenshots, screencast, test credentials

# Pricing Restructure — 4-Tier Plan (Competitor-Beating)

## Context
The app currently has 3 tiers (Free / Pro $12.99 / Ultimate $24.99). The jump from $0 to $12.99 is too large for small merchants. We're adding a **Starter** tier and repricing all tiers to beat every competitor on both price AND value. The strategy uses "limited access" psychology — Starter gets a taste of advanced features (limited delivery rules, limited waitlist) so merchants see the value and upgrade naturally.

---

## Competitor Analysis

| App | Free | Tier 2 | Tier 3 | Tier 4 | Unique limits |
|-----|------|--------|--------|--------|---------------|
| **Zipprover** (5.0★, 40 reviews) | Basic, 1 rule, branding | $4.99 — 500 checks/mo, CSS | $12.99 — 1K checks, block ATC, product rules | $19.99 — 2K checks, ETA, waitlist | Limits monthly SEARCHES |
| **Zippy** (top competitor) | 1 zone, 750 searches | $5.97 — 3 zones, 2.5K searches | $15.97 — 10 zones, unlimited | -- | Limits zones + searches |
| **SB Zipcode Validator** | -- | $1.99 — unlimited zips, basic widget | -- | -- | Single plan, very basic |
| **Smart Zipcode Tracker** | 250 zips, 500 hits | $4.99 — 500 zips, 2K hits | $9.99 — 2K zips, 5K hits | $14.99 — unlimited | Limits zips + monthly hits |
| **MeroxIO Checker** | 10 zips | $4.99 — unlimited, analytics, ATC block | -- | -- | 2 tiers only |
| **Easy Zipcode (Avocados)** (5.0★, 33 reviews) | -- | $4.99 — unlimited zips | $7.99 — checkout block, CSS | $9.99 — waitlist, social proof | No free plan |

### Our Competitive Advantages (features NO competitor has)
1. **Delivery rules** with fees, cutoff times, delivery days, priority — UNIQUE
2. **No search/check limits** — we never charge per validation (competitors limit 500-2K/mo)
3. **COD availability + return policy display** — UNIQUE
4. **Social proof** (waitlist count on widget) — only Easy Zipcode has this at $9.99+
5. **Zone-based delivery fees** — only Zapiet does this but at enterprise pricing
6. **Cart + checkout blocking** — competitors charge $7.99-$12.99 for this

---

## New 4-Tier Pricing

| | **Free** | **Starter** | **Pro** ⭐ | **Ultimate** |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Monthly** | $0 | $4.99 | $9.99 | $19.99 |
| **Annual** | -- | $39/yr ($3.25/mo) | $79/yr ($6.58/mo) | $149/yr ($12.42/mo) |
| **Annual savings** | -- | 35% | 34% | 38% |
| **Trial** | -- | 7 days | 7 days | 7 days |

### Why this beats every competitor:
- **Starter $4.99** matches market entry price but gives WAY more value (delivery rules + waitlist access, which competitors charge $12.99-$19.99 for)
- **Pro $9.99** undercuts Zipprover ($12.99) and Zippy ($15.97) while offering unlimited everything
- **Ultimate $19.99** matches Zipprover's top tier but includes delivery rules, API, custom CSS — features they don't even have
- **Unlimited searches on ALL plans** — Zipprover caps at 500-2K/mo, Zippy caps at 750-2.5K, Smart caps at 500-5K

| **Zip code limit** | 20 | 500 | Unlimited | Unlimited |

# Built for Shopify Requirements - Comprehensive Extraction

## 1. PREREQUISITES

### 1.1 General Requirements

**Meet App Store Requirements**
- Apps must continue meeting "requirements for distributing apps on the Shopify App Store"
- Apps are audited for these requirements when applying for Built for Shopify status

**Partner Standing**
- Must comply with Partner Program Agreement and Shopify API License
- Partner account must have no active or outstanding infractions
- Previous violations can temporarily impact status based on severity/frequency

### 1.2 Merchant Utility

**Minimum Installs**
- Requires minimum of 50 net installs from active shops on paid plans

**Minimum Reviews**
- Must have at least 5 reviews

**Minimum Rating**
- Must meet minimum recent app rating threshold in Shopify App Store

---

## 2. PERFORMANCE

### 2.1 Admin Performance (Web Vitals)

Apps must use latest App Bridge version to enable Web Vitals metrics gathering. Metrics assessed at 75th percentile of page loads with minimum 100 calls over 28 days.

**Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)**
- "Your app's Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) is 2.5 seconds or less"

**Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)**
- "Your app's Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) is 0.1 or less"

**Interaction to Next Paint (INP)**
- "Your app's Interaction to Next Paint (INP) is 200 milliseconds or less"

### 2.2 Storefront Performance

**Speed Impact**
- "Your app must not reduce the storefront Lighthouse performance score by more than ten points"

### 2.3 Checkout Performance

**Rate Request Response Time**
- Must optimize carrier rate fetching
- Requires minimum 1000 requests over 28 days
- "p95 value of 500ms or less, with a 0.1% failure rate"

---

## 3. INTEGRATION

### 3.1 Embedded Apps

**Embed in Shopify Admin**
- "Apps should be embedded in the Shopify admin using the latest version of Shopify App Bridge"
- Add `app-bridge.js` script tag to `<head>` of every document
- Use session token authentication
- "Apps should not embed external web pages"
- Example given: app shouldn't replicate company website appearance

**Primary Workflows Within Shopify**
- "Merchants should be able to complete primary app workflows inside the Shopify admin"
- Merchants shouldn't need external websites for primary workflows
- Exceptions apply for complex features (e.g., messaging apps requiring continuous monitoring)

**Seamless Sign-Up**
- "Apps should make sign up seamless for merchants, without requiring an additional login"
- Users start using app immediately after installation
- No additional sign-up required
- Exceptions: B2B apps requiring contracts may have complex sign-up if onboarding first asks merchants to connect via existing credentials

**Monitoring and Reporting**
- "Expose key metrics that are helpful for merchants on the app's home page"
- If complex reports exist only externally, include simplified version in admin

**Third-Party Connection Settings**
- "Any settings or configurations that control the connection between Shopify and a third-party system must be available inside the Shopify embedded app interface"
- Example: social media account connection/disconnection via admin

### 3.2 Installation and Asset Management

**Clean Uninstallation**
- "If your app is meant to be used in a merchant's online store, then you need to use theme app extensions"
- Theme app extensions allow seamless integration without code injection
- Blocks automatically removed when app uninstalled

**Asset API Restrictions**
- "Your app shouldn't add, remove, or edit a merchant's theme files"

**Three Exceptions to Asset API Rule:**
1. Page builder apps replacing layout/template files for customization
2. Apps backing up and restoring theme files
3. Apps providing SEO, content locking, or developer tooling (can read via Asset API)

---

## 4. DESIGN

### 4.1 Familiar Design

**Follow UX Best Practices**
- "Your app's UI should mimic Shopify's core look and feel"
- Ensure consistent environment

**Rejection Reasons for UX:**
1. UI is buggy/unpolished (flickering, loading issues, content shifting)
2. Majority content not in card-like containers matching Shopify admin
3. Button styles don't match admin (wrong colors like green/purple)
4. Serif or script fonts for majority of content
5. Body text size significantly different from admin
6. Background color significantly different from admin
7. Tabs modify content above tabs when interacted
8. Inconsistent icons in groups/lists
9. Layout spacing significantly different from admin
10. Text doesn't meet "WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements"
11. Sub-pages lack back button to parent

**Mobile-Friendly Design**
- Responsive, adapts to different screen sizes/devices

**Mobile Rejection Reasons:**
1. Entire page requires horizontal scrolling
2. Content inaccessible on mobile (collapsed without mechanism, no horizontal scroll)
3. Content appears unreasonably condensed (2-column layout remains 2-column)

**Concise App Name**
- "App names in the admin should not truncate in the Shopify navigation menu"

**Navigation Menu Usage**
- "Use the App Bridge s-app-nav to integrate your app's primary navigation"

**Navigation Rejection Reasons:**
1. App has own navigation instead of using Shopify admin menu
2. Navigating to sub-page fails to highlight parent navigation item
3. Separate navigation item besides app name redirecting to homepage
4. Emojis rendered in navigation menu

**Contextual Save Bar**
- "Form inputs should generally be saved using the App Bridge Contextual Save Bar"

**Save Bar Rejection Reasons:**
1. Form doesn't integrate CSB when reasonable to do so
2. When CSB present, merchant can navigate away without interacting with Save/Discard

**Modal Usage**
- Use s-modal heading attribute for titles
- Use primary-action and secondary-actions slots for buttons

**Modal Rejection Reasons:**
1. Primary/secondary buttons appear outside component slots
2. Uses deprecated Fullscreen bar instead of s-app-window and s-page

### 4.2 Helpful Design

**Spelling, Grammar, and Phrasing**
- "Apps must use clear and easy to understand language, proper grammar, and proper spelling"

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. Prominent spelling/grammatical errors in headings, navigation, CTAs
2. Difficult to understand phrases lacking sufficient context

**Helpful Onboarding**
- "Apps should have a concise onboarding experience"

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. Onboarding doesn't sufficiently guide merchants
2. Onboarding isn't concise
3. Onboarding difficult to locate (collapsed, out of view)
4. Installing additional app implied as required step
5. Asking for merchant info without clear justification
6. No mechanism to remove onboarding UI after completion

**Helpful Homepage**
- "Your homepage should clearly indicate if the app is set up and working"
- Indicate performance when possible

**Homepage Rejection Reasons:**
1. App has app block/embed but fails to communicate status using app.extensions()
2. Fails to include metrics/analytics when obvious ones exist
3. After dismissing all dismissible elements, only contains static content

**Helpful Error Messages**
- Errors should be red
- Guide merchants to solutions
- Appear next to relevant fields when possible

**Error Message Rejection Reasons:**
1. Error automatically disappears after time (e.g., toast after 5 seconds)
2. Error appears in non-red color
3. Field highlighted red without corresponding message
4. Contextual error not displayed contextually
5. Form fields display errors pre-interaction

**Guide Merchants to Logical Actions**
- "When presenting a group of related actions, the most logical action should appear visually dominant"

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. All buttons in group presented with same visual treatment
2. Most visually prominent button doesn't represent logical next action

**Visible Previews**
- "If an app allows merchants to customize something visual, merchants must be able to see their changes in real-time"

**Preview Rejection Reasons:**
1. App allows visual customization but fails to provide live-preview
2. On desktop, can't simultaneously view editor and preview

### 4.3 User-Friendly Design

**Don't Make False Claims**
- "Don't guarantee, promise, or strongly suggest merchant outcomes"

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. Language stating merchant outcome (e.g., "increase sales by 18%")
2. Displays incorrect app store ratings in promotions

**Don't Pressure Merchants**
- No visible timers, guilt/shame language, or rewards for 5-star reviews

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. Animated countdown timer for free trial encouraging upgrade
2. CTAs causing guilt/shame (e.g., "No thanks, I prefer less sales")

**Don't Distract Merchants**
- No unnecessary animations, modals, popovers, or colors

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. Modal/popover auto-appears on load, after time, or from unrelated action
2. Large elements dramatically animate into view
3. Animation draws attention unrelated to merchant action
4. Red used for non-error/non-destructive purposes

**Don't Overwhelm Merchants**
- Avoid poorly organized forms, overwhelming text, multiple banners

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. Single large complex form instead of logically subdivided fields
2. Two or more banners in close proximity
3. Large amounts of text instead of concise, scannable copy

**Don't Impersonate Shopify**
- "Don't do anything that might reasonably lead a merchant to mistake your app for a first-party Shopify app"

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. App icon could be mistaken for first-party app (similar gradient)
2. Uses Shopify Sidekick icon or Shopify's magic purple for AI features

**Dismissible Ads**
- "Advertisements and/or promotional content must be dismissible by merchants"

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. Promotional content not dismissible
2. Same/similar content appears again after dismissal

**Label and Disable Premium Features**
- Features gated by plan must be disabled visually and functionally
- Shopify Plus-exclusive features must be hidden for non-Plus merchants

**Rejection Reasons:**
1. Plan-gated feature interactive and appears enabled
2. Plan-gated feature interactive but visually disabled
3. Plan-gated feature non-interactive but visually enabled
4. Plus-exclusive feature visible to non-Plus merchants
5. Multiple tiers without clear feature requirements

---

## 5. CATEGORY-SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

### 5.1 Ads Apps

**Use Web Pixels**
- "If your app provides ad attribution, audience creation, segmentation, analytics, pixels, retargeting, or lookalike targeting, it must create and use Web Pixel extensions"
- Cannot use script tags or require JavaScript copying

**Use Shopify Segments**
- "Your app must allow merchants to use any segment defined in the Shopify admin when targeting advertisements"
- Must implement customer segment action extension

### 5.2 Affiliate Program Apps

**Use Web Pixels**
- Must create and use Web Pixel extensions for relevant events
- Cannot use script tags or require merchants to copy JavaScript

### 5.3 Analytics Apps

**Use Web Pixels**
- Must create and use Web Pixel extensions
- Cannot use script tags

### 5.4 Carrier Services Apps

**Minimum Request Volume**
- Requires minimum 1000 requests in last 28 days

**Response Speed**
- "Over the last 28 days, the carrier rate endpoint provided by your app must respond in fewer than 500 milliseconds for 95% of calls"

**Reliability**
- "Over the last 28 days, the carrier rate endpoint provided by your app must successfully respond to 99.9% of requests"

### 5.5 Discount Apps

**Use Discount Primitives**
- "Your app must either use discount functions to define custom discount types or use the native discount APIs to create discounts"

**Don't Use Draft Orders**
- "Your app must not create draft orders to give custom discounts"
- Drafts designed for one-off flows, not automated customer flows

**Single Redeem Code Per Discount**
- "Your app must use the discountRedeemCodeBulkAdd mutation to create any discounts with multiple redeem codes"

**Create High-Quality Links**
- Links from Create discount button must direct to embedded app page
- Must follow all relevant App Design Guidelines

### 5.6 Email Marketing Apps

**Use Web Pixels**
- "If your app provides automation, segmentation, analytics, or pixels, it must create and use Web Pixel extensions"

**Sync Customer Data**
- "Your app must sync all customer information to and from Shopify as required"

**Use Shopify Segments**
- Must allow merchants to use segments when targeting
- Implement customer segment action extension

**Help Identify Visitors**
- "Your app must use the visitors API to log identifying information, such as emails or phone numbers"

### 5.7 Forms Apps

**Use Shopify Segments**
- Must allow merchants to use segments when targeting
- Implement customer segment action extension

**Help Identify Visitors**
- Must use visitors API for identifying information

**Sync Customer Data**
- Must sync all customer information to and from Shopify

### 5.8 Fulfillment Services Apps

**Actively Fulfill Orders**
- "Your app must be active and have fulfilled 100 or more fulfillment orders in the last 28 days"

**Complete Fulfillment Orders**
- "Your app must have completed 99% of the fulfillment orders assigned to it in the last 28 days"
- Excludes orders created in last 7 days
- Incomplete states: open, submitted, in_progress with various substates

**Respond to Callbacks**
- "Your app must have responded successfully to 99% of Shopify callback requests"

**Wait for Merchant Requests**
- "Your app must only fulfill fulfillment orders after a merchant requests fulfillment"

**Add Tracking Information**
- "In the last 28 days, your app must have added tracking information to 80% of the fulfillments that it creates within one hour of creation"
- Can populate company/URLs at creation or update later

**Respond to Fulfillment Requests**
- "In the last 28 days, your app must have responded to 99% of fulfillment requests within four hours"

**Respond to Cancellation Requests**
- "In the last 28 days, your app must have responded to 99% of cancellation requests within 1 hour"

### 5.9 Invoices and Receipts Apps

**Enable Printing**
- "Your app must use an admin print action extension to let merchants print invoices or packing slips"
- Must work on individual order detail pages and bulk selection

### 5.10 Product Bundles Apps

**Use Bundles Primitives**
- "Your app must either use the GraphQL Admin API to create static bundles or use a cartTransform function to create customized bundles"
- Exceptions for unsupported use cases (unsupported channels, subscriptions, post-purchase order editing)

### 5.11 Product Reviews Apps

**Provide Flow Trigger**
- "Your app must provide a Flow trigger that starts a workflow whenever a new review is collected"

**Use Block Extensions**
- "Your app must provide an admin block extension on customer detail pages"
- Gives access to customer reviews

### 5.12 Returns and Exchanges Apps

**Sync Returns Information**
- Must use appropriate APIs for all return lifecycle events:
  - Creating returns
  - Shipping creation
  - Restocking
  - Removing items from return
  - Cancelling return
  - Closing returns
  - Providing refunds

**Include Exchange Line Items**
- "Your app must create exchange line items on an order when managing exchanges"
- Must remove exchange lines if no longer needed

**Include Shipping and Restocking Fees**
- "Your app must add shipping fees and restocking fees on an order when applicable"

### 5.13 SMS Marketing Apps

**Use Web Pixels**
- "If your app provides automation, segmentation, analytics, or pixels, it must create and use Web Pixel extensions"

**Sync Customer Data**
- Must sync all customer information to and from Shopify

**Use Shopify Segments**
- Must allow merchants to use segments
- Implement customer segment action extension

**Help Identify Visitors**
- Must use visitors API for identifying information

### 5.14 Subscription Apps

**Use Subscription Objects and APIs**
- Must use: Selling plan API, Subscription contract API, Customer payment method API

**Use Theme App Block Extensions**
- "Your app must add subscriptions on product detail pages by using an app block"
- Must be compatible with Online Store 2.0

**Follow Subscriptions UX Guidelines**
- Subscription info (name, price, savings) clearly displayed on product, cart, and order pages
- "The subscription option information must automatically match the color palette, font, font-size, and font weight of the store's current theme by default"

**Use Customer Account UI Extensions**
- "Your app must use Customer Account UI extensions to enable customers to view and manage their subscriptions"

---

## SUMMARY OF KEY METRICS

| Metric | Threshold |
|--------|-----------|
| Minimum Installs | 50 net installs (paid plans) |
| Minimum Reviews | 5 reviews |
| LCP | ≤2.5 seconds (75th percentile) |
| CLS | ≤0.1 (75th percentile) |
| INP | ≤200ms (75th percentile) |
| Storefront Speed Impact | Max -10 Lighthouse points |
| Carrier Rate Response | <500ms (95th percentile) |
| Carrier Rate Reliability | 99.9% success rate |
| Fulfillment Completion | 99% of orders |
| Fulfillment Request Response | 99% within 4 hours |
| Cancellation Response | 99% within 1 hour |
| Tracking Info Addition | 80% within 1 hour |
| Callback Success | 99% of requests |
| Minimum Data Points | 100+ calls over 28 days (Web Vitals) |
